testPolicy.value: For Fall 2027 first-year admission, the University of Iowa uses a no-harm test policy: applicants may apply without ACT/SAT scores, and submitted scores are used only when they benefit admission or scholarship review. International applicants who completed secondary school outside the United States generally do not need ACT/SAT scores for admission, but scores may be required for scholarships, certain direct-admission programs, or the Honors Program; English-proficiency requirements remain separate.
